parity_gap.note: Controller mTLS parity closed; live StandardAuthorizer still blocked pending quiesce/roll/ACL/canary

accepted_exception.description: Retain existing shared kafka.keystore.jks dual-use leaf (serverAuth+clientAuth) for INTERNAL/EXTERNAL/CONTROLLER server role and broker/controller client role

compensating_controls: application clients remain dedicated clientAuth-only leaves
fail-closed StandardAuthorizer only after controller parity + canary
recovery-admin isolated Secret outside application mounts

connection_edge_model.derive_denominator_from: KRaft quorum voters + live controller registration telemetry after enablement
